decisions.statement: A seat whose role is handler is named for its domain alone.
A seat of Alan's is named for its persona where that persona is not the default.
An empty attribute is left out of the name the same way a missing attribute is.
The name is the parts that remain joined with a hyphen.
A seat with no part remaining has no name.
A flex spelled anything but flex- followed by a whole number gives no name.
A name that is exactly a person's slug is that person's rather than a spelling of the seat.
A name that is no person's slug moves with the attributes that name was composed from.

definition: the name a seat goes by, spelled from the attributes the seat has
